skills.description:
【中文】
上线验 LaunchCheck 是独立第三方系统层 AI 质检裁判。上线前或每次改完后，它自动从 15 个维度（安全 / 性能 / 体验 / 合规等）验证已落地运行系统的效果是否达标，输出系统质量验收报告、代码修复工单与标准覆盖度报告。支持循环验证，达标自动停止。它与「开工验 PreCheck」同源出品、共用底座（标准库 / 维度 / 风险等级 / 术语）、格式互通。核心原则"只裁判不参赛"——只评测、只下发工单，绝不修改、不部署任何业务代码；改代码交给你的开发 Agent 或团队。适合独立开发者、创业团队、AI 应用构建者。¥4.99/次，按量计费。

【English】
LaunchCheck is an independent third-party AI quality inspector for running systems. Before launch or after each change, it automatically verifies results against 15 dimensions (security, performance, UX, compliance…) and outputs a System Quality Acceptance Report, code-fix work orders, and a standard-coverage report. Supports continuous validation until all standards are met. Built by the same team as PreCheck, sharing the same base (standard library / dimensions / risk levels / glossary). Core principle: inspector only, never an athlete — it only reviews and issues work orders, never modifying or deploying your code; your dev agent or team does the fixing. Designed for indie developers, startup teams, and AI app builders. ¥4.99/call, pay-per-use.
